About CircuitHub

CircuitHub is reshaping electronics manufacturing with The Grid, a factory-scale robotics platform that makes small-batch, high-mix electronics assembly radically more efficient. Think semiconductor-fab precision applied to the chaotic world of prototyping and low-volume production: a 10x throughput improvement in one of the world's most foundational industries.

We've raised $45M from top-tier investors including Plural, Y Combinator and Google Ventures, and we're already profitable. Our customers include a major EV maker, a top AI lab and many of the worlds largest companies.

The Grid isn't a prototype. It's live, scaling fast and delivering real revenue, and we're building the team that will scale it further.

Remote within the UK, or from our offices in London or Cambridge if you prefer.

The opportunity

CircuitHub is trying to solve a difficult problem: why can software engineers iterate almost instantly while hardware engineers can still wait weeks or months to manufacture a new design?

The company was founded by engineers who had experienced that frustration first-hand. What began as software to make ordering electronics easier has evolved into a much more ambitious manufacturing platform, combining software, robotics and automation to redesign the production process itself.

Today CircuitHub operates an automated electronics manufacturing platform serving hardware businesses across areas including robotics, autonomous systems and other advanced technology applications. Its proprietary Grid system is a factory-scale robotic assembly platform designed for rapid, high-mix electronics production.

The business is now scaling quickly. CircuitHub has raised $45 million to expand manufacturing capacity in both the US and Europe, building on operations in Massachusetts and its growing UK presence. Cambridge is becoming an increasingly important hub alongside London and the company's distributed team.

That growth creates a corresponding need to strengthen the operating infrastructure behind the company. Finance is one of the areas where CircuitHub has deliberately remained lean for longer than it probably should have.

Context: where finance is today

The finance team is led by a Finance Director and Management Accountant, both experienced, qualified accountants. This role brings dedicated financial accounting and technical reporting capability into the team, taking ownership of the books, the audit and the technical questions that come with a growing international group.

CircuitHub uses NetSuite to operate its inter-company financial model across the UK and US. A significant amount of day-to-day UK finance activity is outsourced, while the internal team takes greater ownership of the larger US operation, group reporting and consolidation. This role will be the main point of contact for the outsourced firm, reviewing their work and making sure it meets the standard the group needs, while also working across the US side and the wider mechanics of an international business.

Just as importantly, CircuitHub is thinking carefully about what the next generation of finance roles should look like. AI and automation are already being deployed across the company, including in areas where repetitive finance work can be made considerably more efficient.

That makes strong technical accountants even more important. CircuitHub needs people who understand the numbers well enough to judge whether automated output is right, and who can use technology to improve how finance works without weakening control.

That combination of technical accounting, real ownership and a technology-enabled way of working is a central part of the opportunity.

The mandate

The Group Financial Accountant will take ownership of CircuitHub’s financial accounting across the UK and US. That means understanding how the books are put together, running a reliable close and being the person the Finance Director, the auditors and the outsourced accounting firm rely on for accurate, well-supported numbers.

Alongside the core accounts, the role will lead on technical accounting as the business scales. CircuitHub is investing heavily in manufacturing capacity and moving towards more flexible commercial models, which raises questions around revenue recognition, capitalisation and intercompany that need a clear owner.

The candidate must be willing to get their hands dirty to get a full appreciation of the sales cycle & work with the Finance Director to improve our systems and controls to improve our collection cycle, reducing DSO & further automation for our credit offering.

The candidate should have a good technical understanding in accounting that can lead to developing financial operations without complicating or delaying the reporting process. Developing our systems to improve the speed and efficiency of areas such as revenue recognition, R&D capitalisation & the consolidation process.

What you will work on

The precise balance will evolve with the candidate, but the remit is expected to include:

  • Financial accounting and close. Own month-end, including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance sheet reconciliations, with a clear understanding of how the accounts fit together.

  • Audit and statutory reporting. Act as the first point of contact for the auditors, manage their requests and prepare supporting schedules under UK GAAP and IFRS.

  • Technical accounting. Lead projects such as IFRS 15 revenue recognition, the capitalisation policy and the treatment of intercompany transactions as the business and its commercial models develop.

  • Group reporting. Support reporting across the UK and US entities, including intercompany reconciliations, and contribute to group consolidation in NetSuite where experience allows.

  • Outsourced provider management. Manage the relationship with the UK outsourced accounting firm, reviewing their output and holding it to the standard the group needs.

  • NetSuite and finance systems. Work directly in NetSuite and across the different systems and platforms that feed into it. Understand how data moves through the business rather than treating the accounting system in isolation.

  • AI and automation. Review and take ownership of automated and AI-generated finance output, making sure it is accurate and properly controlled, and help identify where further automation makes sense.

What success looks like

The first objective is to be a safe pair of hands. That means solving outstanding technical issues, taking ownership of monthly & quarterly close, a well-run audit and numbers the Finance Director and the team can trust without needing to revisit them.

From there, success means taking ownership of the technical agenda: a clear approach to revenue recognition as commercial models change, a robust capitalisation policy as CircuitHub invests in capacity, and clean intercompany accounting across the UK and US.

Over time, the finance team should have the capacity to report more frequently, stronger oversight of outsourced work and less technical accounting sitting with the Finance Director simply because nobody else can own it.

Processes should improve as well as move faster. Automation should remove low-value work without weakening financial control.

This is a role to build into over time. The scope will grow with the finance function and with the contribution the individual makes to it. As the business scales, the role is expected to grow into Group Financial Controller.

The person we are looking for

CircuitHub is looking for a qualified or near-qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA) with strong technical foundations. The specific qualification matters less than acumen, drive and personal qualities.

You are likely to have trained in practice, whether at a Big 4 or a top 20 firm, and be looking for your first move into an operating business. Alternatively, you may already be working in industry, in which case you will be qualified or close to qualifying.

The strongest signals are:

  • Relevant exposure. Experience getting the most out of NetSuite, working in a finance team to produce accounting information & ability to work autonomously and conscientiously to meet deadlines.

  • Technical grounding. Strong knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS and a clear understanding of how a set of accounts is put together.

  • Technology fluency. You are comfortable working across systems and genuinely interested in how AI is changing finance. You see automation as a tool, not a substitute for judgement.

  • Practical curiosity. When something does not reconcile or a process feels unnecessarily difficult, your instinct is to understand why.

  • Commitment to building. You are motivated by breadth and ownership, and you want to build something over time in a growing business.

  • Interest in the business. CircuitHub sits at the intersection of software, robotics and physical manufacturing. You do not need an electronics background, but an interest in technology and how real products are built will make the environment much more compelling.

Why CircuitHub

This is a chance to join a profitable, fast-growing robotics and manufacturing business at a pivotal stage of scale, in a role with genuine technical ownership.

You will work closely with experienced qualified accountants and gain a breadth of exposure that is rare this early in an industry career: revenue recognition, capitalisation, intercompany, audit and reporting across a UK and US group.

You will also build for where finance is going next. CircuitHub is already using AI, automation and connected systems across the business, creating the opportunity to combine strong technical accounting with skills in systems, data and automation.

For someone with the capability and drive, there is real scope to grow as CircuitHub scales and the finance function builds out around it.

Pay

£75k–£85k, depending on experience, plus equity.

Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

What You'll Do

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

Synthesia is growing fast, and lifecycle is how we turn that growth into lasting customer relationships, guiding every user from first signup to real value. You’ll own the product-led growth motion after signup: the journeys that turn new users into activated, paying and expanding customers. Enterprise Account Executive, TradFi & Web3 Enterprise, MED (France & Italy)

Our Account Executives help organisations adopt digital assets with confidence by connecting their business needs to Chainalysis's blockchain intelligence solutions. They build trusted customer relationships, develop new business, and grow existing accounts through a consultative sales approach.

We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive to cover France, Italy and Malta within our SEMEA team. Your primary focus will be two segments: traditional finance (TradFi), including retail, commercial, private and investment banks, payment and e-money institutions, and asset managers that are launching, supporting or exposed to digital asset activity; and the largest Web3 players, including major exchanges, brokers, custodians, stablecoin issuers and digital asset infrastructure providers operating at scale in France and Italy.

You will own your territory strategy, navigate complex and highly regulated sales cycles, and engage stakeholders across compliance, financial crime, risk, security, procurement, digital assets and executive leadership, from bank CCOs to the compliance and security leaders of large crypto platforms. We measure success through quota attainment, new customer acquisition, and account growth across France and Italy.

In this role, you'll

  • Exceed your sales quota by acquiring new customers and growing existing accounts across France and Italy, with a primary focus on TradFi institutions and large Web3 enterprises.

  • Develop and execute territory and strategic account plans that reflect each market's banking and digital asset landscape, regulatory environment, and buying processes.

  • Build relationships with decision-makers and champions across compliance, AML / financial crime, investigations, risk, security, digital assets teams, and executive leadership, in both TradFi and large Web3 organisations.

  • Create and maintain a qualified pipeline through targeted prospecting, local industry relationships, partner collaboration (consultancies, advisory firms, technology partners), and customer referrals.

  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles from discovery through negotiation and close, working with customers' technical, legal, third-party risk, and procurement teams.

  • Connect Chainalysis solutions to customer outcomes, including managing exposure to crypto-asset service providers and their customers, meeting AML / CFT and sanctions obligations, supporting the safe launch and scaling of digital asset offerings, and investigating illicit activity.

  • Engage customers on how MiCA, the Transfer of Funds Regulation (Travel Rule), DORA, EU AML rules and evolving French and Italian supervisory expectations affect their business needs, working with Chainalysis specialists where appropriate.

  • Position Chainalysis as a partner for both worlds: help banks build confidence in digital assets, and help large Web3 players meet the compliance expectations of banks, regulators and institutional counterparties. Coordinate with the wider crypto native coverage to avoid overlap on mid-market and early-stage Web3 accounts.

  • Maintain accurate forecasts and clear account plans, with consistent visibility into opportunities, risks, and next steps.

  • Work with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to develop proposals and support customer adoption.

  • Represent Chainalysis at customer meetings and industry events across France and Italy, sharing market feedback to inform regional positioning and messaging.

We're looking for candidates who have

  • 7+ years of B2B enterprise software or SaaS sales experience, including significant experience selling to banks or other regulated financial institutions (AML / financial crime, risk, compliance, fraud, or cybersecurity solutions) and/or to large crypto native organisations.

  • A record of exceeding quota through consultative selling, new business development, and account growth in long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles.

  • Experience developing enterprise accounts in France and/or Italy, with an understanding of local banking and Web3 market practices, procurement and vendor-onboarding processes.

  • A solid understanding of the crypto ecosystem and of the compliance, risk and security challenges facing both banks engaging with digital assets and large exchanges, custodians and infrastructure providers.

  • The ability to translate technical capabilities into clear business outcomes for different stakeholders, from compliance officers to CISOs to C-level executives.

  • Experience using a structured enterprise sales methodology to qualify opportunities, develop customer champions, and manage complex deals.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to engage senior executives and explain complex concepts clearly.

  • Professional fluency in English and either French or Italian, with the ability to sell effectively across both markets.

  • The ability to work independently across a defined territory while collaborating with regional and global teams.

  • A willingness to travel regularly across France and Italy and occasionally elsewhere in the SEMEA region.

Nice to have

  • Professional fluency in both French and Italian.

  • Established relationships within French and Italian banks, payment institutions, large crypto platforms, and financial services associations.

  • Experience selling blockchain analytics, financial crime, KYC / transaction monitoring, fraud prevention, cybersecurity, or data analytics solutions to banks.

  • Familiarity with MiCA, the Travel Rule, DORA,European AML requirements, and the roles of relevant French and Italian authorities (e.g. ACPR, AMF, TRACFIN, Banca d'Italia, CONSOB, UIF).

  • Experience selling to banks launching digital asset services (custody, trading, tokenisation, stablecoins), or to large Web3 players serving institutional clients.

  • Experience working with local industry associations, advisory and Big 4 firms, and technology partners to develop a territory.


AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the role

Every airframe Harmattan AI flies starts with a model. System identification turns flight data into the verified dynamics that guidance and control are designed, tuned and trained on. It is the foundation of an autopilot that adapts across multirotors, fixed wings, VTOLs and missiles.

As a System Identification Engineer, working out of Paris, you will own the path from flight test to identified model. You will design and run your own experiments, build a repeatable identification pipeline, and deliver models the G&C team can trust.

 

Responsibilities

  • Experiment Design & Flight Test: Plan and run your own identification tests, from excitation design to flight tests, including coordinating with the .

  • Model Identification: Identify rigid-body, aerodynamic, propulsion and actuator dynamics using frequency and time-domain methods, including closed-loop identification on vehicles flown under a controller.

  • Propulsion & Actuators: Characterize motors, ESCs, propellers and control surfaces, including bandwidth, delays, saturation, and thermal and battery effects.

  • Identification Pipeline: Build and maintain an automated, reproducible pipeline from flight logs to identified model. This covers ingestion, data-quality checks, estimation, validation and reporting.

  • Model Validation: Validate models against held-out flight data, quantify uncertainty, and make sure each model is fit for purpose: controller design, simulation, or training learned G&C.

  • New Airframes: Extend the capability from multirotors to control-surface multirotors, fixed wings, tail-sitters and missiles.

  • Simulation & G&C Support: Deliver models into simulation, SITL and HITL, and work closely with control, guidance and embedded engineers to close the loop between models and flight results.

  • Mentorship: Depending on seniority, support the team by mentoring junior engineers and interns.

 

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: A strong academic record with a degree in aerospace, control, mechanical engineering or a related STEM field. A practical track record matters more than the specific degree.

  • System Identification: Proven experience identifying dynamic models of flying platforms from real data, in both the frequency and time domain, including the pitfalls of closed-loop data.

  • Flight Mechanics & Control: Solid grasp of rigid-body dynamics, aerodynamic forces and moments, non-dimensionalization, stability modes and propulsion models. Also enough control background to know what the model will be used for.

  • Flight Testing: Hands-on experience planning and running flight tests and working from raw, imperfect logs.

  • Software: Strong Python and scientific computing skills, with the discipline to build tools others can rerun.

Nice to have

  • Rigorous about data quality, uncertainty and validation; skeptical of models until they are proven.

  • Autonomous and hands-on, comfortable moving between bench, field and code.

  • Communicates clearly, able to present models and test results to engineers and senior stakeholders.

  • Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment with a no-task-is-too-small mentality.

  • Fixed-wing aerodynamic modeling; VTOL or tail-sitter dynamics; remote pilot certification; experience with real flight logs; structural or vibration modes; data-driven or learned dynamics models.

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI’s mission of providing a defensive edge to allied nations through ethical, high-impact technology.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

Working within a dedicated flight testing team, you will manage, prepare, and operate fleets of newly assembled drones or related product during intensive field validation campaigns. Your technical feedback will directly enable our engineering teams to secure and polish our next-generation defense systems.

data.description:
LIANAKA est une filiale du Groupe Fondasol, spécialiste de l’ingénierie conseil de la construction.

Allier le meilleur des données de sols, de l’IA et de l’analyse humaine dans une plateforme technologiquement avancée, pour permettre aux porteurs de projets de construction d’anticiper les risques et de saisir les opportunités liées à l'environnement des sites de leurs projets : tel est l’engagement de LIANAKA.

Dès la recherche foncière, notre plateforme délivre aux acteurs de la construction un accès direct à une information globale, qualifiée et synthétique des risques et opportunités du sous-sol.

Chaque phase du projet est également l’opportunité d’optimiser les hypothèses techniques et les solutions de travaux.

Les bénéfices directs pour nos clients? Une fiabilité des données du sous-sol optimisée, sur les critères eau, pollution des sols, géotechnique et géothermie. Une meilleure anticipation et maitrise de leurs projets. Des décisions prises plus rapidement. Une identification immédiate des gains financiers. Une contribution à l’empreinte environnementale des projets. Le tout dans un environnement digital convivial et agile. 

Soyez le pivot stratégique de notre transformation numérique : entre expertise technique et performance commerciale, portez le succès d'une solution SaaS qui révolutionne l'analyse des risques de la construction.

Le Projet

Dans le cadre de notre développement numérique, le Groupe FONDASOL a déployé une plateforme SaaS innovante LIANAKA dédiée à la modélisation et l’analyse des risques du sous-sol. Elle offre aux acteurs de la construction une information fiable, rapide et optimisée en amont de leurs projets.

Vos missions

En tant que Chef de Produit, vous êtes le chef d'orchestre de cette solution et votre rôle est transverse :

  1. Comprendre le terrain et l'attente de nos clients

  2. Piloter la technique et l'évolution de la plateforme

  3. Booster le business et la commercialisation de cet outil

Rattaché à la Direction Commerciale et sous la responsabilité du Responsable de la Filiale Digitale, vous êtes au cœur de notre stratégie de croissance et de transformation digitale.

  • Vous recueillez et analysez les besoins clients : compréhension des usages et contraintes des promoteurs, entreprises de TP, collectivités, aménageurs fonciers, ou tout acteur ayant besoin d’anticiper les risques liés au sous-sol dans ses projets

  • Vous transformez les besoins utilisateurs en spécifications fonctionnelles claires et tranchez sur les fonctionnalités à forte valeur ajoutée

  • Vous portez la vision et la roadmap de la plateforme Saas et pilotez l’évolution du produit de la conception au déploiement

  • Vous travaillez main dans la main avec les équipes techniques (Dev, Data, IT, ect.) et garantissez l’adéquation parfaite entre les contraintes techniques et les objectifs business

  • Vous pilotez la croissance du produit en contribuant à sa stratégie commerciale et aux argumentaires commerciaux, tout en accompagnant les équipes marketing et ventes dans le lancement des nouveautés et l'optimisation des performances via le suivi des KPI (adoption, usages, ventes, satisfaction client).

  • Vous êtes le trait d’union entre les clients, les équipes techniques et commerciales

  • Vous sensibilisez les équipes interne aux enjeux du digital tout en étant force de proposition pour optimiser les processus et l’expérience utilisateur.

Ce que nous vous offrons ?

  • La possibilité de participer à la création et au déploiement d’un produit numérique innovant à fort impact

  • Être au cœur de la transformation digitale du Groupe

  • Travailler sur des enjeux concrets liés à l’aménagement du territoire et à la gestion des risques

  • Bénéficier d’une forte autonomie et d’un rôle stratégique dans le développement du produit


Votre profil

  • Issu d'une formation Bac+5 (Ingénieur, Commerce ou Université) avec une spécialisation en digital ou innovation

  • Vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée de 3 à 7 ans en tant que Product Manager, idéalement sur un produit SaaS.

  • Curieux, rigoureux et attiré par l'innovation à fort impact terrain, vous disposez idéalement d'une connaissance du secteur de la construction, du BTP ou de l'aménagement.

  • Doté d'un fort esprit entrepreneurial et d'une grande autonomie, vous maîtrisez le pilotage de produits numériques (roadmap, MVP, itérations) et possédez une réelle capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques ou data complexes.

  • Votre sens business et votre orientation résultats vous permettent de structurer une offre performante, tandis que votre aisance relationnelle fait de vous un leader naturel pour travailler en transverse avec des profils variés (ingénieurs, dev, commerciaux).

Les qualités qui feront votre réussite

Au-delà de vos compétences techniques, nous recherchons une personne avenante, communicante et orientée terrain. Vous aimez aller à la rencontre des clients, comprendre leurs enjeux et créer du lien avec des interlocuteurs variés.

Curieux(se) et proactif(ve), vous ne restez pas derrière votre bureau : vous prenez naturellement l'initiative d'échanger avec les utilisateurs pour identifier les freins à l'adoption de la plateforme et recueillir les retours du terrain.

Grâce à votre excellent relationnel, vous êtes aussi à l'aise avec les clients qu'avec les équipes internes ou les membres du CODIR. Vous savez écouter, convaincre, fédérer et transformer les besoins exprimés en pistes d'amélioration concrètes pour le produit.

Qui sommes-nous ?

INFORMADIS est le partenaire informatique du réseau E.Leclerc. Nos projets vont d’un magasin à plusieurs sites en déploiement simultané. Pour soutenir cette croissance, nous renforçons notre équipe d’avant-vente.

Le poste

Rattaché(e) au Responsable Commerce, vous êtes le pont entre les commerciaux et les équipes techniques. Vous transformez le besoin d’un magasin ou d’une centrale régionale en une solution concrète, chiffrée et convaincante. Vous intervenez sur tout le périmètre infrastructure (réseau et sécurité, téléphonie IP, hébergement), du magasin unique aux réseaux multi-sites, depuis la première visite jusqu’au passage en production.

Vos missions

Recueil et analyse du besoin

  • Qualifier les opportunités avec les commerciaux : périmètre, nombre de sites, enjeux, budget

  • Identifier les risques techniques : câblage, liens opérateurs, fin du RTC, compatibilité du matériel

Conception réseau et sécurité

data.description:
L’investissement à impact est un secteur d’activité en forte croissance. INCO Ventures, acteur clé de ce domaine en France, gère et conseille six fonds d’investissement dédiés au financement des entreprises à fort impact social et/ou environnemental. Il investit principalement dans des cibles en changement d’échelle et/ou en développement (tickets d’investissement compris entre 300k€ et 2M€).

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Nous sommes une société de gestion spécialisée dans l’investissement à impact. Nous accompagnons des entreprises qui contribuent aux grandes transitions environnementales et sociales, tout en recherchant une performance financière attractive pour nos investisseurs.

Au fil des années, nous avons construit nos outils et nos processus autour d’Airtable, de différentes solutions SaaS et d’usages ponctuels de l’intelligence artificielle. Cette organisation nous a permis de grandir rapidement.

Aujourd’hui, nous souhaitons franchir une nouvelle étape.

Notre ambition est de construire une véritable plateforme data et IA au service de l’ensemble de notre écosystème :

  • L’équipe de gestion

  • Les équipes middle office et conformité

  • Nos investisseurs (LPs)

  • Les entreprises de notre portefeuille

Concrètement, nous souhaitons faire évoluer notre architecture de données, automatiser davantage nos processus, déployer des usages IA à forte valeur ajoutée et créer des espaces digitaux permettant à chacun d’accéder simplement aux informations dont il ou elle a besoin.

Pour nous accompagner dans cette transformation, nous recrutons un.e stagiaire qui travaillera directement avec le Responsable Conformité & Middle Office ainsi qu’un.e Directeur.rice d’investissement.

Ce stage est autant un projet de construction qu’un projet d’innovation : nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre les enjeux métier, de proposer des solutions et de contribuer à leur mise en œuvre.


Ce que vous construirez concrètement

Pendant votre stage, vous contribuerez à :

  • Structurer et faire évoluer plusieurs années de données d’investissement, impact et ESG

  • Participer à la migration de notre socle de données vers une architecture moderne et évolutive

  • Déployer des automatisations permettant de réduire les tâches manuelles et d’améliorer la qualité des données

  • Concevoir les premiers assistants IA internes de la société

  • Créer des outils utilisés quotidiennement par les équipes d’investissement, le middle office et la conformité

  • Participer à la création de portails dédiés aux investisseurs et aux entreprises du portefeuille

  • Contribuer à définir notre feuille de route data & IA pour les années à venir


Vos missions

Les projets seront menés en lien direct avec les équipes d'investissement, d’impact, le middle office et la conformité. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement très transversal, avec une forte autonomie et la possibilité de contribuer aussi bien à la réflexion qu'à l'implémentation des solutions. 

Les missions décrites ci-dessous constituent une feuille de route initiale. Elles évolueront naturellement en fonction de l’avancement du projet, de vos centres d’intérêt et des opportunités identifiées ensemble.

  1. Comprendre et structurer notre écosystème de données

Vous participerez notamment à :

  • Cartographier les bases Airtable existantes et leurs usages

  • Comprendre les flux de données entre les différentes équipes

  • Identifier les redondances, points de friction et opportunités d’amélioration

  • Participer à la conception du modèle de données cible

  • Contribuer, le cas échéant, à la migration progressive vers Supabase

  • Structurer les données financières, impact et ESG

  • Définir les règles d’accès et de gouvernance des données

  • Documenter les modèles, processus et bonnes pratiques

L’objectif est de construire un socle de données fiable, partagé et durable.

2. Automatiser les processus clés

Une fois les données structurées, vous contribuerez à automatiser les tâches répétitives et à fluidifier les opérations.

Exemples :

  • Collecte de données auprès des participations, relances automatiques

  • Consolidation de reportings

  • Contrôles de cohérence

  • Gestion documentaire

  • Préparation de certains livrables réglementaires

  • Qualification et enrichissement automatique d'opportunités d'investissement

  • Circulation de l’information entre les outils

Vous participerez à la conception et au déploiement de workflows no-code et low-code, principalement via N8N et les APIs des différents outils utilisés par la société.

3. Déployer des usages IA concrets

Nous cherchons quelqu’un qui saura identifier où l’IA peut réellement créer de la valeur.

Vous pourrez notamment travailler sur :

  • Des assistants internes connectés à nos bases de données

  • Des outils de recherche documentaire et de gestion des connaissances

  • L'extraction automatique d'informations depuis des rapports, questionnaires ou documents de due diligence

  • La pré-analyse de dossiers d'investissement

  • La génération assistée de reportings, mémos d’investissement et comptes-rendus

  • Des workflows mêlant automatisation et IA

  • L’exploration de nouveaux cas d’usage liés à l’investissement, à l’impact ou à la conformité

Vous serez encouragé.e à expérimenter, comparer les solutions disponibles sur le marché et proposer vos propres idées.

4. Construire les interfaces et portails utilisateurs

À mesure que les fondations seront en place, vous participerez à la création des interfaces permettant aux différents utilisateurs d’accéder simplement à l’information. Cela pourra inclure :

Portail équipe de gestion

  • Suivi des participations

  • Reporting portefeuille

  • Outils internes de pilotage

Portail investisseurs (LPs)

  • Consultation des reportings

  • Suivi des indicateurs de portefeuille

  • Diffusion sécurisée des informations réglementaires

Portail participations

  • Collecte de données

  • Suivi des indicateurs financiers et extra-financiers

  • Partage documentaire

5. Accompagner l’adoption des nouveaux outils

La réussite du projet ne dépend pas uniquement de la technologie. Vous contribuerez également à :

  • Comprendre les besoins des utilisateurs

  • Identifier de nouveaux cas d’usage

  • Former les équipes aux outils déployés

  • Produire une documentation simple et utile

  • Diffuser les bonnes pratiques liées à la data et à l’IA

  • Réaliser une veille active sur les nouveaux outils et tendances du marché

Pourquoi ce stage est différent

Vous ne rejoindrez pas une équipe technique isolée mais travaillerez directement avec les équipes métiers :

  • Notre Responsable Conformité & Middle Office

  • Notre Chief Impact Officer

  • Nos Directeur.rices d’investissement

Vous serez exposé.e à des problématiques à la fois stratégiques, opérationnelles et technologiques.

Vous participerez à la transformation d’une société de gestion de l’intérieur, avec une forte autonomie et un impact visible dès les premières semaines.

Les outils et processus que vous contribuerez à construire seront utilisés au quotidien par les équipes, les investisseurs et les entreprises que nous accompagnons.

C’est une opportunité rare de développer une expertise à l’intersection de l’investissement, de la data, de l’automatisation et de l’intelligence artificielle.

Candidature

Envoyez-nous votre CV accompagné de quelques lignes expliquant :

  • Ce qui vous attire dans ce projet

  • Un outil, une automatisation ou un usage IA que vous avez déjà mis en place (ou que vous aimeriez explorer)

Pas besoin de lettre de motivation formelle.

Nous privilégions les personnes curieuses, pragmatiques et motivées à construire.


Nous recherchons avant tout une personne curieuse, autonome et orientée solutions.

Vous pourriez être la bonne personne si :

  • Vous êtes en école d’ingénieur, école de commerce, université ou équivalent

  • Vous avez une forte appétence pour la data, l’automatisation et l’IA 

  • Vous aimez expérimenter de nouveaux outils

  • Vous êtes capable de transformer un problème métier en solution concrète

  • Vous savez avancer de manière autonome tout en travaillant en équipe

Des compétences ou expériences dans les domaines suivants seront appréciées :

  • SQL et bases de données relationnelles

  • Airtable, Notion, N8N, Make ou outils similaires

  • APIs et intégrations

  • IA générative et prompting

Mais nous accordons autant d’importance à la curiosité, à la capacité d’apprentissage et à l’esprit d’initiative qu’aux compétences techniques.

data.description:
Fastned is on a mission to accelerate the transition to electric mobility. Since 2012, we have been building and operating a rapidly growing network of iconic fast-charging stations across Europe powered entirely by solar and wind energy. With 500+ colleagues, we now operate over 450+ stations across nine countries, with an ambitious goal of reaching 1,000 stations by 2030. We are not building infrastructure for its own sake. Every station we open is a tangible step in the transition away from fossil fuels. This role offers you the unique opportunity to be at the forefront of driving this transition across France, Italy and Spain.

The role

As Head of Expansion South-West Europe, you will accelerate the reliable, high-quality expansion of sites for our charging stations across France, Spain and Italy. You will translate strategy into clear regional priorities, practical plans and effective ways of working. You will lead and coach the Expansion Leads and Expansion team members across your region, support cross-functional collaboration and ensure that risks, dependencies and opportunities are visible and addressed. The role combines people leadership, strategic implementation and governance. You will strengthen local ownership while creating alignment, sharing learnings and improving execution across the South-West region.

This role is based in Paris (France) and requires regular travel within Europe.

Your responsibilities

1. Tactical support and people leadership

  • Lead, coach and develop the Expansion Leads and additional team members across France, Spain and Italy.

  • Establish a consistent operating rhythm covering performance, funnel reviews, forecasting, risks and action tracking.

  • Use data and business insights to identify blockers, support needs and capacity requirements.

  • Coordinate cross-functional support and help resolve dependencies while strengthening country autonomy.

2. Strategic implementation

  • Translate ‘Network Development’ priorities into clear regional and country actions.

  • Support Expansion Leads and Country Directors in developing aligned expansion plans and strategic roadmaps.

  • Drive the adoption of new initiatives, processes and tools across the region.

  • Monitor market, competitor, regulatory and customer developments and turn relevant insights into recommendations.

3. ‘Network Development’ leadership and governance

  • Represent the South West region in Network Development strategy, planning and portfolio discussions.

  • Assess projects and initiatives based on value, risk, dependencies, capacity and strategic fit.

  • Ensure country implications are considered early and that approved projects are implemented effectively.

  • Lead continuous improvement by embedding lessons learned, standardising successful practices and tracking measurable outcomes.

What success looks like

  • You ensure that Expansion Leads have clear priorities, decision space and the support needed to deliver.

  • Expansion plans and roadmaps are aligned with Network Development strategy and local market realities.

  • Risks, dependencies and performance issues are identified early and addressed effectively.

  • Strategic initiatives and project outcomes are adopted consistently across the region.

  • Successful ways of working are shared, standardised and scaled across countries.

Who we are looking for

You are a genuine people leader who inspires, challenges, and grows the people around you. You bring:

  • Significant relevant experience in expansion, commercial, infrastructure, real estate, energy, mobility or a comparable field in an international environment.

  • Experience leading teams or senior professionals across multiple countries or markets, demonstrating your ability to adaptively lead and inspire.

  • A proven ability to translate strategy into practical plans, implementation and measurable results.

  • Strong commercial acumen, analytical skills and experience coordinating cross-functional stakeholders.

  • A coaching-oriented leadership style, strong communication skills and the confidence to challenge constructively.

  • Professional fluency in both French & English is required. Fluency in Spanish or Italian would be an advantage.

  • Affinity with Fastned's mission: a genuine belief in the energy transition.

Join us in building a better future

We are on a mission to make a positive impact, but we don't forget to recognise & celebrate our successes, big and small. We put a focus on work-life balance, provide you with genuine work flexibility and have family-friendly policies in place. We offer you a wide range of attractive secondary benefits. Just to mention a few:

  • A training and development budget of €3,000 per year per employee, because development and training are important to us and our sector offers endless opportunities.

  • In order to experience and enjoy the EV life, you get access to our fully electric vehicle fleet (all charging expenses covered).

  • A meal voucher card, worth €12.20 per day.

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus RTT days and 2 Mission Days, which you can use to contribute to Fastned’s missions and support a charitable cause that matters to you.

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que stagiaire de Master 2, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de formation, recherche et innovation, au sein du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (LGF, UMR CNRS 5307), Centre SPIN. Dans ce laboratoire, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal. Le LGF est une unité mixte de recherche CNRS et Mines Saint-Étienne. Il étudie la structure, les propriétés et la réactivité des matériaux, des poudres aux procédés énergétiques. Sa force : relier ce qui se passe à l’échelle du cristal à la performance d’un procédé.

Le stockage d’énergie thermochimique stocke la chaleur sous forme d’énergie chimique, grâce à des réactions solide-gaz réversibles. Les hydrates de sels inorganiques absorbent de la chaleur lors de leur déshydratation et la restituent lors de leur réhydratation, ce qui en fait des matériaux candidats pour le stockage de chaleur. Leur performance en cyclage dépend des structures cristallines traversées entre les états d’hydratation, dont le volume de maille et la symétrie peuvent différer fortement.

Les caractérisations ex situ, avant et après réaction, ne donnent accès qu’aux états extrêmes, pas au chemin de transformation. Ce stage suivra la transformation in situ afin d’identifier quelles phases apparaissent, dans quel ordre et avec quelle cinétique, et de comprendre pourquoi la réhydratation peut rester incomplète. Les hydrates de SrBr₂ servent de système modèle ; l’approche s’étend à d’autres hydrates de sels et à d’autres réactions gaz-solide.

• Vous réalisez une revue de la littérature sur les hydrates de sels pour le stockage thermochimique.

• Vous menez des cycles de déshydratation/réhydratation suivis par diffraction des rayons X in situ, sous température et humidité contrôlées.

• Vous quantifiez les fractions de phases par affinement de Rietveld (TOPAS, GSAS-II).

• Vous reliez structure et performance (fraction récupérée, vitesse de réaction, stabilité en cyclage).

• Vous rendez compte de vos résultats dans un mémoire et une présentation orale, avec une publication possible.

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et faire dialoguer expérimentation, structure et performance sera essentielle pour réussir.

Vous préparez un diplôme Bac + 5 (Master 2 ou dernière année d’école d’ingénieurs) en science des matériaux, physique, chimie du solide ou génie des procédés.

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

La production de béton est responsable d'environ 8 % des émissions mondiales de CO2. Ces émissions sont principalement liées à la combustion et à la décarbonatation du calcaire nécessaire à la production du ciment Portland conventionnel.

Les liants à base de magnésie (MgO) sont étudiés comme alternatives potentielles aux ciments conventionnels, avec une empreinte carbone réduite. Le magnésium nécessaire à leur production pourrait être extrait de roches non carbonatées ou de saumures riches en magnésium. Ces ressources constituent des sources alternatives de matières premières et pourraient permettre d'éviter les émissions de CO2 liées à la décarbonatation du calcaire.

Cependant, ces liants alternatifs sont encore en cours de développement et leurs mécanismes d'hydratation, leur composition et leurs propriétés mécaniques doivent être mieux compris. En particulier, la nature et la réactivité de la source de magnésium, ainsi que les conditions de formulation et de préparation, peuvent influencer la microstructure et les performances mécaniques du matériau obtenu.

L'objectif de ce stage est d'étudier différentes sources de magnésium et d'évaluer leur potentiel pour le développement de liants de type MgO-SiO2 présentant de bonnes propriétés mécaniques et un impact environnemental réduit.

Plusieurs formulations de liants seront préparées et étudiées en faisant varier la source de magnésium et différents paramètres de formulation. Les matériaux obtenus seront caractérisés à l'aide de techniques complémentaires afin d'évaluer leur composition chimique, les phases formées lors de l'hydratation, leur microstructure, leur porosité et leurs propriétés mécaniques. Les principales étapes du stage seront les suivantes :

·        Étude bibliographique : synthèse des connaissances sur les liants magnésiens, leurs mécanismes d'hydratation et leurs applications potentielles.

·        Caractérisation des matières premières : étude de la composition chimique et minéralogique, de la distribution granulométrique (PSD) et de la réactivité des matières premières sélectionnées.

·        Formulation et préparation des liants : élaboration de pâtes de ciment de type MgO-SiO2 en utilisant différentes sources de magnésium et différents paramètres de préparation.

·        Caractérisation des matériaux : analyse des pâtes hydratées par diffraction des rayons X (DRX), analyse thermogravimétrique (ATG), microscopie électronique à balayage couplée à la spectroscopie à dispersion d'énergie (MEB/EDS), mesure de la porosité accessible à l'eau et essais mécaniques.

Analyse des résultats : comparaison des différentes formulations afin d'identifier les principaux paramètres influençant leur microstructure et leurs propriétés mécaniques.

Sujet proposé (5-6 mois à partir de Février):

Acronyme : HOPAL : Hospital Process Automatic Learning

Titre long : Construction automatique de modèles de processus hospitaliers multi-flux par grands modèles de langage (LLM)

Description du projet :

L’étude du processus de prise en charge aux urgences est essentielle pour comprendre et résoudre le problème croissant de surcharge, qui touche de nombreux pays. Cette surcharge, souvent liée à un déséquilibre entre la demande de soins et les ressources disponibles, a des conséquences graves : retards de traitement, allongement des temps de triage, et même une augmentation de la mortalité. Elle révèle aussi des défis systémiques, comme l’accès difficile aux soins primaires, qui poussent les patients vers les urgences.

Optimiser l’utilisation des ressources humaines et matérielles permet non seulement de réduire les files d’attente, mais aussi d’améliorer la qualité des soins et l’efficacité globale du système. Enfin, analyser ces processus aide à identifier des solutions durables, comme une meilleure organisation ou une réallocation ciblée des moyens.

Ces processus laissent des traces numériques dans le système d'information hospitalier (SIH), mais leur modélisation reste aujourd'hui largement manuelle, coûteuse et rapidement obsolète.

Le process mining permet de découvrir des modèles de processus à partir de ces traces. Les techniques classiques de découverte atteignent toutefois leurs limites face à des logs hétérogènes, bruités et multi-flux.

Les grands modèles de langage (LLM) ouvrent une voie nouvelle : générer automatiquement des modèles de processus (BPMN, graphes de processus) directement à partir de traces organisationnelles, sans intervention humaine, et en produire une lecture compréhensible par les acteurs de terrain.

Par ailleurs, des travaux menés au CGI ont démontré la faisabilité de la prédiction de parcours patients par LLM. La question scientifique au cœur de ce stage est l'articulation de ces deux briques : comment relier la prédiction de parcours à la construction automatique de modèles, pour passer de modèles rétrospectifs (ce qui s'est passé) à des modèles prospectifs (ce qui va se passer) ?

Ce projet s’inscrit dans une dynamique inter-écoles IMT autour de l’IA explicable pour la santé publique. Les équipes CGI, CIS et SAMOVAR collaborent déjà via le projet TRACKING (Carnot M.I.N.E.S – CARINGS), avec des travaux sur la géolocalisation indoor au sein des urgences de l’Hôpital Le Corbusier de Firminy. Cette synergie s’est prolongée par un stage M2 en 2025, financé par le Fonds d’amorçage Santé, dédié au prototypage d’une application mobile de localisation indoor/outdoor des patients. Une thèse INTERCARNOT a été lancé dans la continuité avec la validation des deux instituts Carnot (M.I.N.E.S et TSN) et va démarrer en Octobre 2026.

Objectif du stage

L'objectif est de concevoir et prototyper un pipeline dans lequel un même module de construction automatique de modèles par LLM est alimenté par deux sources :

  • Branche A (rétrospective) : les logs SIH réels, normalisés en event logs, produisent des modèles as-is des processus observés ;

  • Branche B (prospective) : dans la suite des travaux réalisés, les parcours prédits par LLM sont sérialisés au même format de traces (activité, timestamp, ressource) via un adaptateur, et produisent des modèles to-be des processus à venir.

La comparaison des modèles as-is et to-be permet la détection d'écarts, l'anticipation des goulots d'étranglement et le support à la décision explicable, jusqu'à la simulation contrefactuelle (perturber les prédictions, reconstruire le modèle, observer l'impact).

Profil recherché

  • Formation : M2 ou dernière année d'école d'ingénieur en informatique, science des données, IA ou génie industriel ;

  • Compétences techniques : Python indispensable ; une expérience des LLM (fine-tuning, prompting, API)

  • et/ou du process mining (pm4py) est un atout fort ;

  • Qualités : rigueur scientifique, autonomie, goût pour le travail avec des données réelles imparfaites, intérêt pour le domaine hospitalier.

Références

Huguet M, Pehlivan C, Ballereau F, Dodane-Loyenet A, Fontanili F, Garaix T, Yordanov Y, Augusto V, Tazarourte K, Redjaline A. Indoor positioning systems provide insight into emergency department systems enabling proposal of designs to improve workflow. Commun Med (Lond). 2025 Mar 11;5(1):72.

Ayed SB, Layeb SB, Huguet M, Fontanili F, Samama N. Developing a Mobile Application and Dashboard for Proactive Management of Patient No- Shows via Geolocation and Dynamic Scheduling. In: 2025 IEEE International Conference on Advanced Healthcare Systems (ICAHS). IEEE; 2025 Dec. p. 1-5.

PROJECT OVERVIEW

We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).

The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.

A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.

Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.

Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.

KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:

1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.

2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.

3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).


REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.

• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.

• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.

• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.

• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES

• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.

• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.

HOW TO APPLY

Please prepare a single PDF file containing:

1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.

2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.

3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

We are building AI to simulate the world through merging art and science.

We believe that world models are at the frontier of progress in artificial intelligence. Language models alone won’t solve the world’s hardest problems – robotics, disease, scientific discovery. Real progress requires models that experience the world and learn from their mistakes, the same way that humans do. And this kind of trial and error can be massively accelerated when done in simulation, rather than in the real world.

World models offer the most clear path to general-purpose simulation, changing how stories are told, how scientific progress is made and how the next frontiers of humanity are reached.

Our team consists of creative, open minded, caring and ambitious people who are determined to change the world. We aspire to continuously build impossible things and our ability to do so relies on building an incredible team. If you are driven to do the same, we'd love to hear from you.

*Titles posted to our careers page are updated regularly to best advertise the role and expected seniority, but internally we have a flat titling system with two types of titles: one for individual contributors and one for people managers.

About the role

Preferable to have someone near one of our offices in NYC or San Francisco.

Runway’s Commercial Counsel Fellowship is an intensive, full-time, 1 year venture dedicated to fostering high caliber early-career lawyers who want to build real in-house experience at a fast-moving AI company. You'll work directly alongside our Commercial Counsel team on live deals from your first weeks, with hands-on training and mentorship along the way.

No prior commercial or in-house experience is required. We care more about sharp judgment, strong writing, and a fast learning curve than a specific background. Comfort working in a highly technical, rapidly evolving area of the law is a must. Whether you're coming from a law firm, a clerkship, or straight out of law school, we'll teach you how to negotiate commercial agreements and partner with the business.

 

What you'll do

  • Draft, review, and negotiate Runway's commercial agreements, including B2B SaaS customer contracts for our generative AI platform and APIs, DPAs, partnership agreements, and vendor agreements, taking on more complex deals as you ramp

  • Partner with the sales team with fast, practical answers that help close deals

  • Help scale and automate our commercial processes and tools, including templates, playbooks, contract review automation, and our legal tech stack

  • Learn the technical side of our generative AI products inside and out, so your advice to the business is grounded in how they work

  • Research and track technical, legal, and policy developments in generative AI, and share what matters with the team

  • Depending on your interests, contribute to projects across the broader legal team, such as privacy, IP, product counseling, or compliance

 

What you'll get

  • Hands-on training in commercial contracting and in-house practice, with real ownership from early on

  • Mentorship from experienced in-house lawyers, with regular feedback on your work

  • Exposure to cross-functional teams across sales, partnerships, product, and marketing, and to the Runway Executive Team

  • A front-row seat to the legal questions shaping generative AI video

  • Potential to convert to a full-time role at the end of the fellowship, in Commercial Counsel or another area of the legal team

 

What you'll need

  • A J.D. plus admission in good standing with at least one state bar (or sitting for the bar before the fellowship starts)

  • 0–3 years of legal experience, for example at a law firm, in a clerkship, in an in-house or government role

  • A strong academic record and excellent legal writing and analytical skills

  • Bias for action and a willingness to take ownership

  • Growth mindset and an eagerness to learn quickly, take feedback, and improve how things get done

  • Clear, practical communication with non-lawyers

  • Operational mindset

  • Excitement about generative AI and motivation to continuously learn more about the legal landscape governing a new and exciting industry

 

Nice to have

  • Exposure to technology transactions, SaaS agreements, IP, or data privacy, through practice, coursework, a clinic, or a summer associate role

  • Experience using AI tools in your own legal work

  • Familiarity with how AI or software products are built

FAQs

  • Are there specific fellowship start dates or can I start anytime?

    • We do not currently have specific start dates. Start dates can be year round.

  • I am 10 years out of law school. Can I still apply for the fellowship?

    • The fellowship is meant for early-career lawyers (first 3 years of legal practice). However, lots of lawyers take different, non-traditional paths. If you are an experienced lawyer who is early in your commercial counsel career, you are still welcome to apply. Explain your career transition and interest in commercial legal work in your application.

Runway strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity for our team. Our salary ranges are based on competitive market rates for our size, stage and industry, and salary is just one part of the overall compensation package we provide.

There are many factors that go into salary determinations, including relevant experience, skill level and qualifications assessed during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below is a general expectation for the function as posted, but we are also open to considering candidates who may be more or less experienced than outlined in the job description. In this case, we will communicate any updates in the expected salary range.

Lastly, the provided range is the expected salary for candidates in the U.S. Outside of those regions, there may be a change in the range, which again, will be communicated to candidates.

Working at Runway

Great things come from great teams. We’d love to hear from you.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. So regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply.

At Loft Orbital, we have just successfully launched multiple satellites that we fly and operate ourselves. With these satellites in orbit and a wave of exciting missions launching soon, we are scaling up quickly as a global company.

We are looking for a Test Infrastructure Engineer to join the team building and maintaining Loft’s test infrastructure internationally across our Golden, CO and Toulouse, France sites.

About this role:
As a Test Infrastructure Engineer, you will primarily help design, develop, and deploy our test infrastructure and the tools for automating both our hardware and software testing, which will help us scale as a company.Sitting between the spacecraft and all the other teams, you will have a big impact in ensuring that every element of our satellite works without any bugs.We are looking for engineers with a product mindset, who have a good understanding of embedded systems, networking, data exchange protocols, and experience with setting up software infrastructures. Additionally, we are looking for someone who is:
  • Able to work independently with some guidance. People owning their work is important to us!
  • Able to wear multiple hats as needs arise. We are a small company disrupting an entire industry!
  • Not afraid to get out of their comfort zone to explore and learn. Technologies are evolving at rapid rates, and we must stay relevant!
    • Key responsibilities include:
    • Design, build, deploy, and maintain high-fidelity Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testbeds that emulate spacecraft systems, sensors, and communication links.
    • Design, build, deploy, and maintain Electrical Ground Support Equipment (EGSE) that interfaces with space vehicles under Assembly, Integration & Tests, allowing Validation and Verification of spacecrafts and their software before their launch campaigns.
    • Develop tools and frameworks that allow teams to simulate faults, edge cases, and mission scenarios that are difficult or costly to reproduce with physical hardware alone.
    • Work closely with systems, software, hardware, and operations teams to understand evolving test requirements and integrate feedback into the platforms.
    • Maintain and extend test infrastructure to support continuous integration (CI) pipelines, ensuring every code change is validated with realistic system-level tests.

      • Our culture at Loft Orbital promotes collaboration and ownership among our developers, fostering efforts hand in hand with other teams, internally and externally.

Must Haves:
  • 2+ years working with Linux systems, including configuration, debugging, and system-level troubleshooting.
  • Strong understanding of networking fundamentals (OSI layers, packet analysis, data exchange protocols like TCP/IP and UDP).
  • Hands-on experience with embedded systems or low-level hardware (Raspberry Pi, Arduino, microcontrollers, or similar).
  • Proficiency in Python (3.9+) for building test automation frameworks, device drivers, or test orchestration tools.
  • Experience containerizing applications with Docker.
  • Familiarity with at least one modern CI tool (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, Buildkite, CircleCI) and integrating test pipelines.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience with “Infrastructure-as-Code” systems, specifically NixOS.

  • Interest or experience with hardware test automation frameworks (e.g., custom Python-based test rigs).
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or a similar field.

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:

  • Up to 35 days of Paid Time Off (vacations & RTT ) and flexible working hours, we want you to be at your best
  • Health and life insurance, we care about your health
  • Lunch Vouchers, because let’s be honest, we love food! (we even have a slack channel about it #loft-gourmand)

At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions.  We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes.

    Who We Are

    Loft: Space Made Simple. 

    Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

    We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

Compliance Officer / MLRO - Switzerland & Liechtenstein

 

About Keyrock

 

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 180+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris, New York and Chicago.

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

 

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

 

Mission statement

We are looking for an experienced and driven Compliance Officer and MLRO for our Switzerland and Liechtenstein based entities. You will join a dynamic and dedicated Group Compliance team, operating as a key member while focusing primarily on our Switzerland and Liechtenstein operational entities. This role offers an exciting opportunity to make a wider impact across the organization by working on broader, group-level projects, allowing you to contribute to the global compliance framework and help grow the group as a whole.

 

Job description

 

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant laws and regulations applicable to Switzerland and Liechtenstein by developing and implementing the policies and procedures ;

  • Conducting compliance risk assessments and elaborating an annual compliance plan;

  • Developing and implementing a plan of second-line controls and conducting the tests;

  • Assessing future business activities to identify potential compliance risks;

  • Ensuring the firm’s policies and procedures are being communicated effectively to all relevant employees;

  • Ensuring the compliance trainings are effective and up to date;

  • Keeping abreast with regulatory changes and maintaining the policies and procedures up to date;

  • Collaborate with internal departments such as Trading Operations, Finance, Risk management, IT & Security, etc… to integrate compliance requirements into business processes.

  • Being responsible for oversight of Keyrock CH and LI compliance with its AML obligations and acting as a focal point for the firm’s AML activity (MLRO).

  • Carrying out the duties of a MLRO as per the AML/CTF Framework

  • Representing Keyrock CH and LI in all matters of money laundering prevention internally and externally;

  • Serving as a subject matter expert on AML/CTF matters, providing guidance and support to the compliance team and other departments;

  • Conducting regular audits and reviews to ensure compliance with AML/CTF requirements and internal policies

  • Drafting of compliance points of attention and recommendations and assisting the Group Head of Compliance or Group General Counsel (Group level) with management information reports;

 

Background and experience

  • Solid experience as a Compliance officer (2nd line of defense) in a regulated financial institution in Switzerland and/or Liechtenstein, ideally with exposure to MLRO responsibilities or similar

  • Experience in engaging with Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory authorities;

  • Excellent knowledge of financial regulations such as MiCAR, AML/CTF, market abuse , data privacy;

  • Understanding of the digital assets ecosystem is a major plus;

  • A relevant degree, preferably in business or law, is required;

  • Extensive experience in implementation of monitoring and control processes to support policies and procedures;

  • A compliance qualification for example ACAMS or a Masters in a related field would be an advantage;

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We look for self-aware candidates who bring both the core skills required for the role and a deep alignment with our performance principles. We seek fiercely passionate, mission-driven people who communicate with purpose and practice proactive ownership. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who prioritizes mission over ego, maintains a commercial mindset, and delivers long-term value through pragmatic flexibility.

Our offer

 

  • A competitive salary and benefits package

  • Annual Team Retreats: a yearly offsite dedicated to strategy, celebration of our wins and fun team activities

  • Opportunity to work remotely

  • Fast-paced, highly intellectually stimulating working environment

  • The freedom to create your own entrepreneurial experience by being part of a team of people in search of excellence

 

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

 

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.
