Wil jij bouwen aan de vastgoedopgave én aan een nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie? Als ervaren ontwikkelaar bij Dura Vermeer Bouw & Vastgoed werk je aan grootschalige vastgoedprojecten in Midden-Nederland. Je stapt in na acquisitie en bent verantwoordelijk voor de verdere ontwikkeling richting verkoop en realisatie. In een ondernemende omgeving krijg je alle ruimte om mee te bouwen aan het team, je expertise in te zetten in de samenwerking met adviseurs én door te groeien naar een rol met meer inhoudelijke en coachende verantwoordelijkheid.

 

Dit wordt jouw baan

Ondernemend, ervaren en klaar om impact te maken? Dan voel jij je thuis binnen deze nieuwe ontwikkelorganisatie van Dura Vermeer. Als senior Projectontwikkelaar werk je aan omvangrijke vastgoedprojecten en help je niet alleen projecten verder te brengen, maar ook het team en de organisatie. Je begrijpt hoe ontwikkeling en bouw elkaar versterken, neemt eigenaarschap en krijgt de ruimte om mee te denken, mee te bouwen en mee te groeien. Je bent betrokken vanaf de fase na acquisitie / tendergunning en schakelt intensief met de het ontwikkelteam om projecten succesvol verder te brengen.

 

Wat ga je doen
De focus ligt op het moment waarop een tender is gewonnen of een acquisitie is verworven en projecten daadwerkelijk ontwikkeld gaan worden. Je werkt aan (middel)grote vastgoedontwikkelingen en ben je de verbindende factor tussen ontwikkeling en bouw. Dat maakt deze rol ideaal voor een ervaren ontwikkelaar die energie krijgt van het uitwerken van projecten, ondernemerschap toont en wil meegroeien met een ambitieuze organisatie.

·       Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling van woningbouwprojecten vanaf tendergunning/acquisitie, naar omgevingsvergunning tot aan de start van de verkoop;

·       Je bewaakt de businesscase en stuurt op waardecreatie gedurende het gehele ontwikkelproces;

·       Je vertaalt ambities en plannen naar concrete ontwikkelbeslissingen die bijdragen aan een succesvolle uitvoering;

·       Je stuurt het ontwikkelproces aan op het gebied van kwaliteit, planning, financiën en risico's;

·       Je verbindt de belangen van gemeenten, adviseurs, beleggers, corporaties, bouwteams en andere stakeholders;

·       Je werkt intensief samen met collega's van Bouw om projecten optimaal uitvoerbaar en haalbaar te maken;

·       Je werkt nauw samen met makelaars, verkoopmanagers en notarissen om projecten succesvol in verkoop te brengen;

·       Je voert regie op vergunningstrajecten, overeenkomsten en besluitvorming;

·       Je draagt actief bij aan de verdere opbouw en professionalisering van de ontwikkelorganisatie.

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis.

Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent iconisch én dichtbij en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken.

Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer maakt.


Hier zit je op jouw plek

Bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Utrecht staan we aan het begin van een nieuw hoofdstuk. Waar we jarenlang bekend stonden als een sterke renovatie/transformatiespecialist, zijn we sinds begin dit jaar uitgegroeid tot een volwaardige Bouw en Vastgoed organisatie. Naast renovatie en transformatie realiseren we nu ook nieuwbouwprojecten in de woning- en utiliteitsbouw én zetten we de volgende stap naar eigen gebieds- en vastgoedontwikkeling.

Dat betekent dat je terechtkomt in een organisatie die volop in beweging is. Met ruim 100 collega's binnen onze werkmaatschappij bouwen we niet alleen aan duurzame woningen, utiliteitsprojecten en leefomgevingen, maar ook aan de toekomst van onze eigen organisatie. De lijnen zijn kort, de ambities groot en de kansen om mee te bouwen aan nieuwe werkwijzen, teams en projecten liggen voor het oprapen.

Hier krijg je de ruimte om impact te maken. Niet vanaf de zijlijn, maar midden in een frisse organisatie die zich verder ontwikkelt en waarin ondernemerschap, samenwerking en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Samen bouwen we aan projecten waar we trots op zijn én aan een organisatie die klaar is voor de toekomst.


Dit breng jij mee

·       Minimaal 5 tot 10 jaar ervaring als projectontwikkelaar;

·       Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding;

·       Ervaring met woningbouwontwikkelingen;

·       Aantoonbare ervaring met complexe projecten;

·       Ruime ervaring met ontwikkeltrajecten in de SO-, VO- en DO-fases, het verkrijgen van omgevingsvergunningen en verkooptrajecten;

·       Ervaring binnen een ontwikkelaar, ontwikkelende bouwer of vastgoedorganisatie.

Je bent een ontwikkelaar die vooral energie krijgt om projecten na tendergunning/acquisitie verder te brengen richting realisatie. Je komt het beste tot je recht wanneer met alle betrokken partijen, de complexe projecten succesvol weet te ontwikkelen én realiseren.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Bovenop salaris komt een vast bedrag Budget Duurzame Inzetbaarheid voor zaken die eraan bijdragen gezond en gemotiveerd te blijven (2,3% volgens cao Bouw & Infra);

Stage communicatie bouwplaatsprotocol

Locatie: Haaften | 32–40 uur | Start: februari, maar mag ook per direct!

Wat jij tijdens je stage maakt wordt straks écht gebruikt op onze bouwplaatsen

Hoe ziet een goed ingerichte bouwplaats eruit? Waar hoort de bewegwijzering? Welke uitstraling geven we bouwhekdoeken? Hoe maken we duidelijk wat de standaard is voor veiligheid, afval, parkeren of bezoekers? En vooral: hoe zorg je dat een uitvoerder niet eindeloos hoeft te zoeken, maar in één oogopslag weet wat nodig is en welk materieel daarbij hoort?

Dat willen we bij Dura Vermeer vastleggen in één Bouwplaatsprotocol: een praktische handleiding én visuele standaard voor de bouwplaats. Het laat zien hoe we onze bouwplaatsen herkenbaar, netjes, veilig en slim inrichten. En dat protocol ga jij helpen maken.

Dit maakt deze stage interessant:

Je zit tijdens deze stage precies tussen communicatie, ontwerp en de praktijk van de bouw in. De ene dag praat je met een uitvoerder over wat er wel en niet werkt. De volgende dag orden je alle informatie die al binnen Dura Vermeer beschikbaar is. Daarna schrijf je een richtlijn zo dat iemand hem in een paar seconden begrijpt en zet je die in Adobe InDesign om in een pagina die ook visueel klopt.

Je hoeft dus niet te kiezen tussen schrijven of ontwerpen. Je doet allebei.

Dit ga je doen:

  • bestaande richtlijnen en informatie binnen Dura Vermeer verzamelen en structureren;

  • bekijken hoe bouwplaatsen nu worden ingericht en waar collega's in de praktijk tegenaan lopen;

  • praten met uitvoerders en collega’s binnen Dura Vermeer Materieel;

  • bepalen welke onderwerpen, standaarden en middelen in het Dura Vermeer-protocol thuishoren;

  • foto's, illustraties, iconen, tabellen en andere visuele middelen maken en inzetten om informatie snel duidelijk te maken;

  • waar nodig nieuwe communicatiemiddelen of formats ontwikkelen;

  • het complete protocol vormgeven in de huisstijl van Dura Vermeer;

  • kritisch testen of iemand op de bouwplaats er ook daadwerkelijk snel mee kan werken en het protocol op basis van deze feedback verbeteren.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid om na te denken over vragen als: hoe maken we een document van deze omvang prettig om te gebruiken? Wat moet je laten zien in plaats van uitleggen? Welke informatie hoort bij elkaar? Welke dingen helpen een uitvoerder echt verder?


Wat breng jij mee

Voor deze opdracht zoeken we niet alleen iemand die mooi kan vormgeven. En ook niet alleen iemand die goed kan schrijven. Juist de combinatie is belangrijk.

Jij:

  • vindt het leuk om veel informatie terug te brengen tot een logische structuur. Je kunt een technisch verhaal begrijpelijk opschrijven en hebt tegelijkertijd oog voor typografie, beeld, hiërarchie en vormgeving;

  • volgt een hbo-opleiding zoals Communicatie, Creative Business, Communication & Multimedia Design (CMD), Media & Design, Crossmedia Design, Marketingcommunicatie, Visual Communication/Graphic Design of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • schrijft helder en foutloos Nederlands;

  • kunt werken met Adobe Creative Suite;

  • kunt zelfstandig informatie ophalen, ordenen en keuzes onderbouwen;

  • vindt het leuk om collega's uit verschillende vakgebieden te spreken en hun kennis te vertalen naar een bruikbaar eindproduct.

 

Wat bieden wij jou

  • Een afstudeer- of meewerkstage met duidelijke opdracht en zichtbare impact;

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en invulling;

  • Een stagevergoeding van € 700,- per maand; 

  • Begeleiding vanuit communicatie en nauwe samenwerking met collega's uit de praktijk;

  • Een kijkje achter de schermen van de bouwplaats én de materieeldienst.

Waarom dit interessant is

Je werkt niet aan een onderzoek dat in de la verdwijnt, maar aan een product dat straks op al onze bouwplaatsen zichtbaar is. Je combineert analyse, creativiteit en praktijk en levert iets op wat direct gebruikt wordt door uitvoerders en projectteams.

Interesse?

Wil jij bijdragen aan de uitstraling en kwaliteit van onze bouwplaatsen?
Solliciteer en laat zien hoe jij structuur en creativiteit samenbrengt.

Help launch our new temping product and drive commercial impact!

At YoungOnes, data is at the start of every decision. Our Data & RevOps team has a seat at every table and takes a leading role in where the company goes next. Two years ago we rebuilt our data environment in Databricks from scratch, and it is fully ready for the future. There are few better environments to work in.

We are looking for a Data Analyst with a focus on product, who also supports our marketing and commercial teams with deeper analyses. Someone with experience who is ready to take responsibility, and who does not stop at a report but actively steers on the outcome.

What will you do?

Your main focus is product. Next to that, you support marketing and the commercial teams, which keeps your work varied.

Product

In the flexible work market, companies used to choose between temping (uitzenden) and freelancers. Since last year we have been bringing a new proposition to market that sits in between: non-service temping. It combines the legal certainty of temping with the flexibility and personal control of freelancing, all through our platform. This is an important step in our strategy towards one app for work.

  • Take the lead in tracking the progress of this new proposition;

  • Define the KPIs and funnel that show whether the proposition is working;

  • Analyse the full journey of workers and clients, from onboarding to repeat shifts;

  • Spot problems early and actively steer where you see them;

  • Translate insights into concrete improvements together with product and development;

  • Work in a select team that operates as a startup within the company.

Commercial & marketing support

Next to product, you are the analytical sparring partner for our commercial teams and marketing. You go beyond the standard reports and dive deeper when questions get complex.

  • Deliver deeper analyses for the commercial teams, for example on client potential, retention and growth opportunities;

  • Support marketing with insight into campaign results and ROAS.

This role is diverse, but above all it gives you a lot of freedom to take initiative and make an impact.

Your team

You will join an effective Data & RevOps team with 3 Analysts, 2 Engineers, a Performance Manager and 2 Process aAnalysts. You report to the Head of Data.

The data itself is interesting: we support a two sided marketplace with workers on one side and clients on the other. AI is built into the design of how we work and makes the technical side of your job more simple. We use Genie within Databricks, which fully understands our data environment, Claude to connect multiple systems, and Gemini for quick support on smaller tasks.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has at least 3 years of experience as a Data Analyst, Product Analyst or Commercial Analyst;

  • Has experience tracking and steering product performance, and/or with commercial or marketing analytics;

  • Is strong in SQL and familiar with Python/PySpark and a visualisation tool such as Power BI or Amplitude;

  • Has experience with Databricks, or is eager to work in it;

  • Uses AI tooling naturally to work faster and smarter;

  • Takes ownership and dares to make choices and influence stakeholders;

  • Communicates clearly with both technical and non technical colleagues;

  • Is already residing in the Netherlands and is allowed to work in the country and speaks fluent English (Dutch is a plus);

We are not looking for someone who only delivers reports. We want someone who takes the lead, sees problems before others do and makes sure something is done about them.

What do we offer?

  • A gross salary between €4,300 and €6,100 based on full-time employment;

  • 25 vacation days, 6.5 ADV days and 1 additional holiday per calendar year, based on a 40-hour workweek;

  • 8% vacation pay, a pension plan, and (if you live more than 10 km from the office) a travel allowance;

  • We prioritize mental well-being in collaboration with our partner OpenUp;

  • Great perks such as: a yearly fitness budget, a freshly prepared healthy lunch every day, snacks, biweekly afternoon drinks, XL borrels every three months, sport tournaments, and much more;

  • A leading role in a new proposition that is key to our strategy;

  • One of the best data environments to work in, with Databricks and AI built in;

  • A company that is truly data driven, where your insights shape decisions;

  • A high level of autonomy, freedom and responsibility.

YoungOnes is a place where you learn fast, build fast and see results fast. Ready to take the lead? Then we would love to hear from you.

About the role

At YoungOnes, you make sure our platform delivers on its promise: stable, reliable and free of surprises for the people who use it every day. As a QA Engineer you don't work at the end of the chain, but right in the middle of our development teams. You think along before any code is written, test smartly where it matters, and act as the bridge between development, product and the rest of the company when it comes to quality. You report to the Teamlead Frontend and work daily with the frontend, mobile and backend teams.

What you'll do

  • Think along from the start. You join refinements and help teams see the risks and impact of a feature before they start building;

  • Choose the right test approach. Together with the team, you decide per feature what to test automatically, what to test manually, and why;

  • Build and maintain automated tests. You set up tests for key platform functionality and keep them reliable;

  • Manual and exploratory testing. You go through the app yourself, look for edge cases and find what a script misses;

  • Central point of contact for bugs. Bug reports from across the company come to you. You reproduce them, gather all the information a developer needs to get started, and get them ready in Jira with the right priority;

  • Advise on releases. You map out risks and give clear advice on the quality of a release;

  • Provide insight. You collect test data and show how our software quality is doing;

  • Keep the balance. You help teams weigh fixing bugs against building new features.

What you bring

  • A bachelor's level of working and thinking, preferably in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field;

  • At least 2 years of work experience, including at least 1 year as a QA Engineer, Software Tester or Test Automation Engineer;

  • Experience setting up and carrying out a test approach and test plans;

  • Experience with test automation and test frameworks;

  • You're comfortable working with AI tools and use them purposefully: to test faster and better, and to set up automated tests;

  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum team and with a bug tracking system, preferably Jira.

  • You work independently, make decisions in your own work and give advice, whether asked or not;

  • You're critical and analytical, take initiative and work well with developers, product and business.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and you're comfortable working with code;

  • You look beyond "does it work?": also at accessibility, speed, security and multilingual support.

  • Experience with tests that run automatically on every code change, and you know how to deal with unreliable tests;

  • You enjoy sharing knowledge and helping colleagues test better;

  • Experience testing mobile apps.

We're looking for someone who sees quality as something the whole team owns. You don't just perfect your own testing work; you ask yourself what needs to change structurally so the whole team tests better. Our own values guide the way: Own it, Say it, Make it.

What we offer

  • Bewaken van de kwaliteit, volledigheid en consistentie van productinformatie

  • Beheren en actualiseren van artikellijsten, prijslijsten en productdocumentatie

  • Zorgen voor toegankelijke en actuele productinformatie voor interne afdelingen en andere betrokkenen

  • Samenwerken met Sales, Marketing, Techniek, internationale productmanagementteams en klanten

  • Naleven van de geldende HSE-richtlijnen en bijdragen aan een veilige werkomgeving

De FAAC Group omvat 32 bedrijven in 24 landen, met 18 fabrieken in 15 landen en 3 business units. Dankzij deze internationale schaal ontwikkelen en implementeren wij wereldwijd oplossingen voor personen- en voertuigenverkeer, met een sterke focus op kwaliteit, veiligheid en duurzaamheid.

In a world where geopolitical tensions and security threats are accelerating, the way nations protect people and preserve peace is being redefined. For a long time, innovating in defense was about making tougher hardware. But with the evolution of software and the recent AI disruption, the future of defense is shifting to software-powered unmanned systems that save lives by removing humans from the front line. This is our mission.

At Intelic, we're building the intelligence layer for unmanned systems in defense. As a software-first company, we enable autonomous platforms to operate together - faster, smarter, and more reliably - across complex, mission-critical environments. Our technology turns disconnected assets into coordinated forces, helping operators make accurate decisions when it matters most.

Based in Amsterdam and growing fast, Intelic offers a rare opportunity to work on products that don't just move metrics - they meaningfully impact safety, resilience, and the future of Europe's security.

Why This Role Exists

Nexus has to run in places most software never goes: offline, in the field, installed and operated by people who are not developers. Getting it there in one piece, and keeping it running, is a job on its own.

Right now that job sits mostly with three backend engineers who cover this alongside their own work. As Nexus grows, so does the team, and we're adding someone to take real ownership of the pipelines, installers, and infrastructure that turn Nexus into something operators can trust, and who treats security as part of how the work gets done, not a separate project bolted on afterwards.

What You Will Do

You will join Product Adoption, the team that owns the last stretch between working software and a field-ready product: deployment, installers, monitoring, and everything that keeps Nexus running once it leaves the building. We are hiring at medior to senior level, roughly a 2 to 3, with room to flex higher for the right person.

  • Build and maintain the CI/CD pipelines that turn Nexus into an installable, field-ready product across Linux and Windows

  • Maintain and harden our software supply chain, including dependency scanning and package security

  • Own the Windows installer and service orchestration, and help developers debug the platform-specific issues that come with it: permissions, firewalls, services, "works on my machine"

  • Secure the software update server, the one online touchpoint in an otherwise offline system, and keep telemetry from the field reliable without leaking sensitive data

  • Harden APIs and authentication on the surfaces that face the outside world

  • Maintain and gradually take over our on-prem infrastructure: physical servers, backups, and disaster recovery, as we move away from renting machines in the cloud

  • Build small internal tools, mostly in Python, Rust and shell or PowerShell scripts: installers, updaters, and the occasional internal or customer-facing web app

  • Support incident response when things break in production, and help build the monitoring that catches problems before customers do

  • Write down what you learn, so the next person, including future you, doesn't have to debug the same thing twice

You'll Thrive Here If

  • You bring solid experience with CI/CD pipelines and build automation

  • Comfort working across both Linux and Windows, with the ability to actually debug problems on either, not just deploy to them

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Ansible, OpenTofu, or similar)

  • A security mindset: hardening, secure defaults, and attack surface are just part of how you build things, not an afterthought

  • Enough scripting or programming ability to read and contribute to Python, Rust, or shell scripts. There is there is plenty of custom tooling to build.

  • A level head under pressure. You can prioritise and stay steady when a few things break at once

Nice to have:

  • Experience with on-prem, bare-metal or virtulized infrastructure, not just cloud consoles

  • Familiarity with Docker

  • Exposure to dependency and package scanning tools such as Sonatype

  • An interest in platform or infrastructure engineering as its own discipline. We expect this to split into a dedicated function over time

  • Ability to build in-house tooling where needed and integrate vendor solutions where they fit

What Your First Year Will Look Like

  • You've taken over meaningful parts of the CI/CD pipeline and installer work independently, without needing step-by-step instructions

  • You've hardened at least one exposed surface end to end, the update server, an API, or similar

  • You've helped move part of our infrastructure off rented machines and onto hardware we run ourselves

  • Developers come to you when something breaks on Windows or Linux, because you've built a track record of finding the actual root cause

  • You've documented enough of what you know that the team is less dependent on any one person, including you

Why Intelic

  • We are setting up an environment, largely from the ground up that has to approved by MoDs

  • You won't be bored. New projects, new problems, and a steady stream of things nobody has solved here before

  • Real ownership from day one, not ticket-taking. If you see a better tool or approach, you're free to try it

  • You'll work with hardware that matters: servers you can walk up to, deployments running in places with no internet, problems that cloud-only engineers rarely see

  • A small team that leans on each other. When someone's on leave, the rest pick up the slack, and vice versa

  • The mission is real. Nexus supports operators in the field, and how well you build and secure it has a direct effect on whether it works when it counts

What We Offer

  • Stock Appreciation Rights programme (equity)

  • A vibrant office at NDSM Plein, Amsterdam Noord — where we come together in person every day, because we believe it matters for the kind of work we do

  • Flexible pension plan

  • 25 vacation days

  • Travel allowance

  • Urban Sports corporate membership

  • Lease a Bike option

Please note that, as part of our recruitment process, we may request a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and conduct a background screening in accordance with our screening policy. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation throughout this process.

data.description:
About Intelic

In a world where geopolitical tensions and security threats are accelerating, the way nations protect people and preserve peace is being redefined. At Intelic, we're building the intelligence layer for unmanned systems in defense: software that enables autonomous platforms to operate together, faster, smarter, and more reliably, across complex, mission-critical environments.

Based in Amsterdam and growing fast, we offer a rare opportunity to work on products that don't just move metrics. They directly affect safety, resilience, and Europe's security.

Why the role exists

Our drones carry more and more hardware: cameras, gimbals, servos and more. The European market is fragmented, so we need to support many different types of hardware. Right now, adding a new piece of hardware usually means our own engineers have to integrate it. We want to change that. We're building a platform that lets partners and other teams connect their own hardware and write their own driver.

You'll work alongside robotics engineers and help set the team up from the start. The APIs and system design you create will be what everyone else builds on.

If you like hard backend problems where good design directly affects how fast other people can move, this role is worth a look.

What you will do

You'll spend most of your time in Rust, working out how to abstract the communication with the hardware from the rest of the system. That could mean designing how a new camera gets configured through the API, or writing a simulated camera so you can test an integration before the hardware is on your desk.

  • Design and build the platform in Rust

  • Define the APIs that other teams and partners use to integrate cameras, gimbals, servos and other hardware

  • Make it possible for others to write their own drivers and add hardware without needing support from your team

  • Think through how each new module fits into the wider system, and plan for the cases others will run into later

  • Write strong unit tests and add integration tests, including tests against simulated hardware

  • Work directly with other teams to understand what they need from the platform and agree on how systems talk to each other

  • Help set up the team, and hand it over well once the platform is in good shape

You will thrive here if

  • You have around five or more years of engineering experience in a heavy backend language. Rust is ideal, C++ or similar also works

  • You've built platforms or APIs that other teams depend on, and you think about how your part fits into the larger system

  • You work independently. You take a problem, work it out with the team, and see it through without someone managing every step

  • You talk to people. You reach out to other teams, ask questions, and don't wait for work to come to you

  • You take testing seriously, and you know how to test code that talks to hardware

  • You use AI coding tools like Claude in your day to day work

  • You enjoy technical problems more than product decisions. Here, what needs to be built is fairly clear. The job is to build it well

Bonus if you have:

  • Basic hardware knowledge: you know how to power a camera and get video out of it

  • Experience with drones, robotics or other connected hardware

How we work

We're a startup, so we plan about three months ahead and things can change after that. The team you join is small and may not stay in its current form forever. Once the platform is set up, you may move on to work on the wider vehicle platform.

  • Strong unit testing is the standard. Integration tests are added where they make sense, often using simulated hardware

  • Other teams build on your APIs and integrate their own hardware, so you don't have to do every integration yourself

  • Engineers work directly with other teams to agree on interfaces

What your first year will look like

At 6 months: You own this part of the system. The platform is set up, and the team is working at the level you helped set.

At 12 months: The platform runs without you in the middle of it, and you're helping on the wider vehicle platform, including the flight side.

Why Intelic

  • The mission is real. We're building technology that makes Europe safer.

  • Your work multiplies. Set the platform up well, and every team can integrate new hardware without waiting on anyone.

  • You build it from the start. You shape the APIs and the team instead of maintaining someone else's design.

  • You can focus on engineering. The problem is clear. Your job is to solve it well.

What we offer

  • Stock Appreciation Rights program

  • Travel allowance

  • Flexible pension plan

  • 25 vacation days

  • Urban Sports Club membership

  • Bike lease through 'Lease a Bike'

  • A modern office at NDSM Plein, Amsterdam Noord. We value working shoulder to shoulder, so we're in the office 4 days a week. You also get 10 days a year to work from wherever you want.

Please note that, as part of our recruitment process, we may request a Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and conduct a background screening in accordance with our screening policy. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation throughout this process.

Engineering · Amsterdam (hybrid) 

Inner Circle is a dating app for people who are done wasting time. Every member is screened thoroughly, so the profiles you see are people worth dating.


Every AI-powered feature starts with the data and infrastructure behind it. From building scalable backend systems to powering smarter matching and personalisation, our engineers turn data into meaningful connections - and shape how AI transforms the future of dating.


Goal of the Role

You power the engine that brings more members together every second. We’re moving our backend from a PHP monolith to Kotlin services, and changing how we build software at the same time: AI and agentic engineering are part of how our team works every day. You’ll join the team building the new part of our system, and occasionally work in our legacy PHP codebase.


You don’t need prior PHP or Kotlin experience. We care more about how you think and approach problems than about which language you have used so far.


Tech stack: Kotlin, Spring Boot, GraphQL, PHP 8 (legacy), MySQL (Aurora), Redis, OpenSearch, RabbitMQ, Docker, Kubernetes (EKS), AWS (S3, SNS/SQS, SES, Rekognition, and more), DataDog


Result Areas:

Build and ship features that matter to members

Deliver backend features that improve matchmaking, engagement and retention. You work from outcome-based stories: the team agrees on the result, and you own how to get there.

Help move our platform to Kotlin services

Build new Kotlin services and help extract functionality from the PHP monolith step by step, without disrupting the members who use the app every day.

Work with AI, and with judgement

Use AI and agentic tools such as Claude Code in your daily work. Give them clear specs and context, and review what they produce as critically as you would review a colleague’s code.

Own the quality of what you build

Write clean, testable code with automated tests, keep pull requests small, follow secure coding practices, and stay responsible for your code once it runs in production.

Make pragmatic trade-offs

Reason through problems and ship solutions that are good enough. Recognise when something needs more care or optimisation, and ask for input when a decision is bigger than your part of the system.


What you bring:

  • 3+ years of experience in backend engineering

  • Proficiency in at least one typed backend language, such as Kotlin, Java, C#, Go, TypeScript or PHP

  • Solid experience with APIs and relational databases, including query performance

  • Understanding of systems design and software architecture, and the ability to reason about trade-offs

  • You know why clean code matters and you apply it, with or without AI

  • Experience writing automated tests and working with CI/CD

  • Hands-on experience with AI coding tools, or a strong drive to learn agentic engineering practices

  • Clear communication in English, both spoken and written (design docs, decision records, pull request descriptions)


Nice to have:

  • Experience with AWS

  • Experience with event-driven systems or microservice architectures

  • Familiarity with Domain-Driven Design or clean architecture

  • Experience with Kotlin or the JVM

  • Experience working in, and gradually migrating, a legacy codebase


You:

  • Curious, and keen to try new tools and ways of working

  • Focused on outcomes rather than output

  • Pragmatic: you know when good enough is good enough

  • Comfortable asking questions and explaining your reasoning

  • An authentic team player


What we offer:

  • A fulltime job that makes a positive impact on people's lives

  • A competitive salary matched with your experience and ambition

  • An amazing work environment in our office at Prins Hendrikkade, at the heart of Amsterdam

  • A Macbook or other hardware of your choice to be able to do your job

  • Stay healthy and bring your own device allowance

  • Training and development budget

  • Frequent team get-togethers and team activities

  • Free Inner Circle VIP membership for you and your single friends


About Inner Circle

Inner Circle is a dating app built on the contrarian belief: opposites don't attract. The best connections happen between people who already live life the same way. So we don't sell more options, or better odds. We sell relevance, people worth dating. Every member is screened, so effort and intention are in place before anyone gets in. And where every other app is built to keep you swiping, ours is built to get you off it, and onto a date with someone worth your time.


At Inner Circle, we embrace our diverse community and team. We celebrate differences and know that they are key for helping us grow. Our team consists of 40 team members, with 16 nationalities and a female: male ratio of 60 : 40. Whatever your race, religion, colour, gender, national origin, political affiliation, sexual orientation, marital status, disability or age, we make sure everyone has the space to be themselves.

Ready to make an impact? Let's get the ball rolling, apply now.

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Head of Compliance and AML at Doit Lithuania, you will build and run our compliance and anti-money-laundering function from day one.

You will act as our Compliance Officer and AML Officer, and report directly to the management board. You will be independent of the business lines you monitor. You will run compliance and AML for a digital investment platform serving clients in Lithuania and across the European Economic Area.

What You’ll Own

  • Write and own the compliance and AML/CTF policies and procedures.

  • Build the business-wide AML risk assessment, customer risk scoring and risk appetite.

  • Design remote onboarding controls with our KYC partners, including enhanced due diligence for PEPs and high-risk clients.

  • Design and tune transaction monitoring scenarios for brokerage activity.

  • Run sanctions screening at onboarding, on an ongoing basis and on payments.

  • File suspicious activity reports with the FNTT and suspicious order reports under MAR.

  • Run the compliance monitoring programme and report to the board.

  • Approve marketing communications and oversee product governance, complaints and conflicts of interest.

  • Manage the regulatory relationship with the Bank of Lithuania on compliance and AML matters.

  • Prepare the firm for the EU AML Regulation, which applies from July 2027.

  • Build the compliance and AML team as the business grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Significant experience in AML/CTF at a regulated EU financial institution. Ideally at an investment firm, neobroker, neobank or e-money institution.

  • Experience with digital onboarding and remote identity verification at scale.

  • Hands-on experience building risk assessments, monitoring scenarios and EDD processes.

  • Experience filing suspicious activity reports and handling regulatory inspections.

  • Knowledge of MiFID II conduct and investment-services compliance, or the ability to learn it fast.

  • Experience selecting and overseeing KYC, screening and monitoring tools.

  • Strong judgment and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues.

  • Clear, concise writing for policies, board reports and regulators.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a key function holder.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

data.description:
Build with us

Since 2004, we've had one clear goal: to make payments and money management effortless for every business in Europe.

Today, more than 250,000 companies use Mollie to get paid, manage money and grow, with products designed to be simple, scalable, and dependable.

With 950+ Mollies across 14+ locations, we care deeply about autonomy and craft. So we work in small teams, with real ownership, and we trust you to make the right decisions.

We're building for the long term, so we provide the tools you need, processes you can rely on, and a balanced work environment to help you do work you're proud of.

Sound like your kind of place? Let's build together.

Your impact

Credit, IRRBB and capital models sit at the heart of how a bank measures its own risk. Mollie already uses models in day to day processes, but nobody challenges them independently from a second line perspective yet. As Model Risk Officer, you'll help build the second line model risk function that gives Mollie, and its regulator, confidence that models can be trusted before they're used.

This is a true 0 to 1 role. Mollie isn't a bank today, so there's no model risk framework, validation methodology or model inventory to inherit. You'll design the policy, validation approach and governance from scratch, starting with the credit, IRRBB and capital models already in design for our future capital and liquidity planning. Your work feeds into our licence application and, once authorised, into how we manage model risk every day.

You'll also work with our Machine Learning team and the Domains already deploying models, so you can shape how we manage model risk today, not just in a banking future. Your challenge and sign off will be visible to senior leadership, audit and, eventually, our regulator. As Mollie grows and matures its model risk management, your scope grows from building the framework to running an ongoing model risk cycle.

What you'll ship

  • Build and own Mollie's model risk management framework and policy, including model risk appetite, validation standards and the model risk lifecycle.

  • Set up and maintain the model inventory for credit, IRRBB and capital models, with materiality and risk tiering for each.

  • Coordinate independent second line validation and challenge before models are used, including credit risk and ECL, IRRBB, and Pillar 1 and Pillar 2 capital models.

  • Design the ongoing monitoring and re-validation cycle with the Machine Learning team, covering performance testing, limitation tracking and re-validation triggers.

  • Partner with model owners in Credit Risk and Treasury ALM, and coordinate within the second line Risk function, so model risk challenge is built into the wider risk and capital frameworks.

  • Coordinate clear, well documented validation reports and model risk information that stand up to scrutiny from DNB/ECB, external auditors and internal audit.

What you'll bring

  • Around 5 to 7 years of experience in model risk management or model validation within a bank, preferably across at least one of credit, IRRBB and capital models.

  • Solid working knowledge of ECB model risk expectations and how model validation should be structured and evidenced.

  • Comfort building a model risk framework and validation approach from the ground up. You're excited to write the first playbook.

  • Strong quantitative skills to critically assess model methodology, assumptions and performance, and the discipline to document your findings so others, including a regulator, can follow them.

  • The ability to explain model limitations and validation findings to model owners and senior stakeholders, and the confidence to hold your ground under challenge.

  • Genuine curiosity about how AI can speed up the parts of model validation that don't need a human, so more of your time goes toward judgement and challenge.

Grow your way

At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms.

You'll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. Many Mollies move into new roles or take on new projects to stretch themselves, and we actively hire from within to help you take the next step.

No matter if you're aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you'll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.

Unlock your full potential and join us to eliminate financial bureaucracy

If you're excited by the idea of building what's next, for yourself and for thousands of businesses across Europe, we'd love to hear from you. Apply with your CV (in English) using the form below.

Want a peek behind the scenes? Check out what life at Mollie is really like.

AI at Mollie

We believe in Always Be Shipping, and AI brings that philosophy to life across every team, every role, every day.

AI is core to how we build. It helps us move faster, simplify work and make smarter decisions, creating real impact for the businesses we serve. We're looking for people who are excited to use AI to shape the future of finance with us.

De functie

Als HR Consultant zorg je ervoor dat de dagelijkse HR-processen binnen Interconnect soepel en zorgvuldig verlopen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor een correcte personeelsadministratie, bewaakt de kwaliteit van HR-processen en ondersteunt leidinggevenden en medewerkers bij uiteenlopende HR-vraagstukken. Je werkt aan verschillende onderdelen van de employee journey, waaronder in-, door- en uitstroom, verzuimadministratie, personeelsmutaties en werving & selectie. Daarnaast denk je actief mee over het verbeteren van processen en het verder professionaliseren van de HR-dienstverlening.

Je maakt deel uit van een betrokken HR-team, bestaande uit een HR Teamlead, HR Business Partner en HR-medewerker. Het team valt onder de afdeling Business Support.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Beheren en bewaken van de kwaliteit en volledigheid van personeelsdossiers.
  • Verwerken en controleren van personeelsgegevens in HR-systemen, waaronder Nmbrs.
  • Ondersteunen bij de salarisverwerking en uitvoeren van administratieve controles.
  • Adviseren over personeelsregelingen, arbeidsvoorwaarden en HR-procedures.
  • Beantwoorden van HR-gerelateerde vragen van leidinggevenden en medewerkers.
  • Verzorgen van administratieve processen rondom in-, door- en uitstroom en verzuim.
  • Bijdragen aan HR-projecten en de realisatie van HR-doelstellingen.
  • Signaleren van verbetermogelijkheden en optimaliseren van HR-processen en werkwijzen.

Wie ben jij?

Je houdt van structuur, werkt zorgvuldig en vindt het leuk om collega's verder te helpen. Tegelijkertijd kijk je kritisch naar bestaande processen en denk je actief mee over hoe zaken slimmer en efficiënter kunnen worden georganiseerd.

Je beschikt over:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding.
  • Kennis van HR-processen, personeelsadministratie en relevante wet- en regelgeving.
  • Bij voorkeur enkele jaren werkervaring als HR-medewerker, HR Consultant of in een vergelijkbare functie.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een klantgerichte instelling.
  • Een proactieve, nauwkeurige en resultaatgerichte werkhouding.
  • Beschikbaarheid van minimaal 32 uur per week.
  • Ervaring met Nmbrs is een mooie aanvulling.

Wat biedt Interconnect?

Je komt terecht bij een stabiel en groeiend familiebedrijf waar samenwerking, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en een prettige werksfeer centraal staan.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tot € 4.250 op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis, ervaring en opleidingsniveau.
  • Een jaarlijkse prestatiebonus die kan oplopen tot één bruto maandsalaris.
  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling waarbij Interconnect gemiddeld twee derde van de premie betaalt.
  • 25 vakantiedagen op fulltime basis, met de mogelijkheid om maximaal 10 extra dagen bij te kopen.
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,21 per kilometer of volledige vergoeding van het openbaar vervoer.
  • Mogelijkheid om maximaal 40% van de contracturen vanuit huis te werken.
  • Een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan en mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en trainingen.

Daarnaast kun je rekenen op:

  • Een moderne werkomgeving in het hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, inclusief lunch-/werkcafé, gaming room en skybar.
  • Een eigen fitnessruimte met moderne apparatuur en groepslessen onder begeleiding van een professionele trainer.
  • Regelmatige teamactiviteiten, waaronder een zomer-BBQ, game nights, vitaliteitsdagen en teamuitjes.

Over Interconnect

Interconnect is een Nederlands familiebedrijf dat sinds 1995 actief is in de wereld van IT-infrastructuur, datacenters en clouddiensten. Met ongeveer 130 medewerkers en eigen Tier III-datacenters in ’s-Hertogenbosch en Eindhoven levert Interconnect veilige en betrouwbare IT-oplossingen aan onder andere managed service providers, softwarebedrijven en zakelijke eindgebruikers. De organisatie speelt een belangrijke rol in de digitale infrastructuur van Nederland en combineert technologische expertise met de betrokkenheid en korte communicatielijnen van een familiebedrijf.

Interesse?

Ben jij een ervaren HR-professional die klaar is voor een leidinggevende rol met impact?
